title: Onboard verdant-14b-v1.0: metadata, performance profiles, and changelog automation
author: Ava Patel
body:
Motivation: Add support for the new community model verdant-14b-v1.0 to the model registry with production-ready metadata, validated performance profiles, and automated changelog/release note entries. This PR is intended to let customers select verdant-14b from the catalog with accurate latency/cost estimates and ensure that onboarding is auditable and traceable via changelog automation.

What I changed: 1) Added a model card and metadata YAML for verdant-14b-v1.0 (license, tokenizer, recommended context lengths, precision/quantization guidance, sample prompts). 2) Introduced calibrated performance_profiles for the common sequence-length buckets we use in perf tooling (sustained throughput, p50/p99 latency on T4 and A10G, memory footprint estimates). Profiles include measured traces from our perf-canary harness and recommended instance sizes for Dedicated. 3) Hooked the new model entry into the changelog automation pipeline so that model additions generate a release_notes entry and a structured changelog line in the model-registry release manifest. 4) Added unit/integration tests that validate metadata schema, profile ranges, and the changelog generator mapping. 5) Minor docs updates (catalog README and onboarding checklist).

How this was validated: - Ran our eval-harness perf jobs on the perf-canary cluster (see attached perf logs) to generate the performance profiles; results were reviewed by Samir. - CI: model-registry unit tests + integration tests + lint all passed on the final run. One earlier CI run failed linting (long lines in generated examples) and was fixed in the final commit. - Manual QA: verified catalog page renders correctly locally and the changelog automation emits an entry in the release manifest when the model metadata file is added.

Checklist: - [x] Model metadata added and schema-validated - [x] Performance profiles generated and attached - [x] Changelog automation mapping updated - [x] Tests added/updated - [x] Docs updated

Backward compatibility: No breaking changes to existing models or APIs. The changelog automation is additive and gated behind the model-registry CI job.

Related: ENG-3912 (onboarding workflow improvements), PM-814 (product request for verdant availability).

Notes for reviewer: focus review on metadata fields for licensing and tokenizer config (we default to bpe with a 50k vocab), perf profile numbers (Samir provided the raw traces), and the automated changelog mapping (it should only auto-emit when metadata.version is present).

Merge: squash and merge after approvals.
commits: c3b9f2a - Add verdant-14b-v1.0 metadata and model card
a7d4e10 - Add raw perf traces and generate performance_profiles/verdant-14b-v1.0.json
e91f4b6 - Hook verdant entry into changelog automation map and release manifest
b2c6d4f - Add tests for metadata schema and changelog generator
f7e2a01 - Fix lint issues reported by CI
review_comments: Miguel Torres: Left a couple of comments on the perf profile thresholds - p99 on A10G looks optimistic for 2k context, can we call out measurement error/variance.
Ava Patel (author): Added a note in performance_profiles about sample variance and included 95% CI for p99; updated profile to use conservative provisioning recommendation.
Elena Rossi: Approved after reading the metadata schema changes and docs update. Minor nit on README wording.
Samir Gupta: Verified raw traces and signed off on numbers. Approving.
release_notes:
- Onboard verdant-14b-v1.0: model card and metadata; recommended deployment flavors and tokenizer config.
- Add calibrated performance profiles (T4/A10G) with latency and throughput guidance.
- Changelog automation: model additions now generate structured release entries for the catalog.
merge_description: Squash-merged after approvals. All CI green. Added conservatized p99 CI notes per reviewer feedback.
notes: This PR is part of the Q4 model onboarding wave; verdant is community-licensed (MIT-compatible) but requires the tokenizer config workaround for BPE merges to match upstream. The perf profiles were generated with the perf-canary harness commit a7d4e10; keep the trace artifacts for future audits.
